cues.en: This video is an exercise and it follows up on a previous couple of videos about generating random numbers.
cues.zh: 這段是練習，延續前幾段產生隨機數的內容。

cues.en: So what you want to do in this video is come up with a plot of unit vectors, so vectors for the length of one that have random phase angles.
cues.zh: 目標是畫出單位向量，也就是長度為 1、具有隨機相位角的向量。

cues.en: Now, you already know several different ways of coming up with random numbers.
cues.zh: 已經知道幾種產生隨機數的方法。

cues.en: So a couple of different distributions and ways of stretching and shifting those distributions.
cues.zh: 幾種不同分布，以及拉伸、平移分布的方式。

cues.en: So I'm not going to tell you exactly which parameters to use, but you can figure that out.
cues.zh: 不直接指定用哪些參數，請自行判斷。

cues.en: I think there are some sets of distributions that are more sensible for generating vectors and a unit
cues.zh: 有些分布適合用來產生單位，

cues.en: circle with random phase angles and other vectors that are not so sensible.
cues.zh: 圓上隨機相位角的向量，另一些就不太適合。

cues.en: So it's a bit open ended.
cues.zh: 所以題目有點開放。

cues.en: So you can post the video, switch to Python and write some code and when you're finished writing your code, then come back and you can see what I have to say about this problem.
cues.zh: 可以暫停，切到 Python 寫程式，完成後回來看看我怎麼說。

cues.en: So let's start by generating some random numbers, I would call this variable NGS for angles not to
cues.zh: 先產生一些隨機數，把變數叫 angs，代表 angles，別和，

cues.en: be confused with angst, which is a quality that teenagers tend to have.
cues.zh: 青少年常有的焦慮 angst 混淆。

cues.en: So let's say numpad that random and let's start with normally distributed random numbers.
cues.zh: 用 np.random，先從常態分布隨機數開始。

cues.en: I will generate one hundred of them and then to plot them, I'm going to put this in a loop.
cues.zh: 產生 100 個，用迴圈畫出來。

cues.en: I'm going to loop through all of these angles and let's see at each iteration of this loop.
cues.zh: 跑過全部角度，每一輪，

cues.en: But we want to do is generate a vector in the unit circle.
cues.zh: 要在單位圓畫一個向量。

cues.en: And I talked about this in the section on Algebra two.
cues.zh: 代數二章談過這件事。

cues.en: So the X component goes from zero to the cosine component of the angle, which is now variable.
cues.zh: x 分量從 0 到這個角度的餘弦，這裡角度是，

cues.en: I in this for loop and the y axis change goes from zero to the sine component of the angle.
cues.zh: for 迴圈的變數 i，y 軸則從 0 到角度的正弦。

cues.en: And I'm not going to specify color actually will let Python pick some random pretty colors for this plot.
cues.zh: 先不指定顏色，讓 Python 替圖挑些漂亮顏色。

cues.en: All right.
cues.zh: 好。

cues.en: So then we want to actually let's see how it looks like this.
cues.zh: 先看看這樣的外觀。

cues.en: OK, so I kind of have a few things to say about these angles in a moment.
cues.zh: 稍後有幾件事要談這些角度。

cues.en: But first, I want to make this look a little bit nicer.
cues.zh: 先讓它漂亮一點。

cues.en: So let's say we should make the Axis Square for one thing.
cues.zh: 首先，把座標區域設成正方形。

cues.en: Let's see.
cues.zh: 看看。

cues.en: OK, that looks a bit better.
cues.zh: 好一點了。

cues.en: And then I'm going to define the ranges, actually.
cues.zh: 接著定義範圍，其實，

cues.en: Now, I think I'll just turn this axis off.
cues.zh: 先直接關掉座標軸。

cues.en: Let's say let's not f f, but o f.
cues.zh: 不是 ff，是 off。

cues.en: All right.
cues.zh: 好。

cues.en: Actually, I do want to set the axis explicitly, so I will write that the axis should go from minus one to plus one and minus one to plus one.
cues.zh: 其實還是想明確設定軸，從 -1 到正 1，以及 -1 到正 1。

cues.en: All right.
cues.zh: 好。

cues.en: So now you can see the circle clearly.
cues.zh: 現在清楚看到圓。

cues.en: You can see all these unit vectors with random angles.
cues.zh: 看得到全部隨機角度的單位向量。

cues.en: Now, why are there so few angles over here and more angles over here?
cues.zh: 為什麼這邊角度這麼少，那邊這麼多？

cues.en: Maybe that's just how these happen to be randomly drawn.
cues.zh: 也許只是這次剛好隨機抽到這樣。

cues.en: So I run this again a few times and you can see that it's basically always the same.
cues.zh: 反覆執行幾次，卻會看到基本上一直相同。

cues.en: We always get not zero vectors.
cues.zh: 不是完全沒有向量，

cues.en: There are some vectors pointing off to the left, but relatively few.
cues.zh: 左邊也有一些，但相對少。

cues.en: And it seems like there's more clustering around here.
cues.zh: 這裡似乎聚集比較多。

cues.en: And now the reason why that's happening is because this is a normal distribution that I'm drawing from.
cues.zh: 原因是，抽的是常態分布。

cues.en: So that means that most of these angles are close to zero and zero for an angle is pointing over here and these values are vectors with angles over here.
cues.zh: 所以多數角度接近 0，而 0 角度指向這裡；那些，

cues.en: Pointing off to the left are going to have angle values close to PI, so close to around three.
cues.zh: 向左的向量，角度值會接近 π，也就是大約 3。

cues.en: And you will recall from a few videos where I talked about normal distributions that values around three are relatively unlikely.
cues.zh: 記得，前幾段談過常態分布，3 附近的值比較不容易出現。

cues.en: OK, so that means that I would argue that a normal distribution of random numbers is not really well,
cues.zh: 因此我會認為，常態分布的隨機數，

cues.en: it's not wrong, but it's not really the most appropriate distribution to draw from for random phase angles like this, random angles for these vectors.
cues.zh: 並非錯，但不太適合這種隨機相位角、隨機角度的向量。

cues.en: So therefore, let's just get rid of this NP here and make this uniformly distributed numbers.
cues.zh: 所以拿掉這個 n，改成均勻分布的數字。

cues.en: All right.
cues.zh: 好。

cues.en: And now it looks kind of funny, actually.
cues.zh: 現在看起來有點好玩。

cues.en: I wouldn't say funny.
cues.zh: 其實，不該說好玩。

cues.en: This looks like a fan.
cues.zh: 這像扇子。

cues.en: It looks like a beautiful, colorful fan.
cues.zh: 漂亮的彩色扇子。

cues.en: Again, this isn't really wrong because I didn't give you any instructions for what the right answer should be.
cues.zh: 這仍不算錯，因為沒有指定正確答案應該是什麼。

cues.en: However, I think you can also agree with me that this is probably not the most appropriate distribution for phase angles on the unit circle.
cues.zh: 不過，相信你也同意，這大概不是最適合單位圓相位角的分布。

cues.en: So what is a better distribution?
cues.zh: 什麼更好？

cues.en: Well, I think a better distribution will cover the entire range, cover the entire circle, basically randomly and uniformly.
cues.zh: 我覺得，更好的分布應該隨機、均勻地涵蓋整個範圍、整圈。

cues.en: So therefore, what we need to do is convert this distribution from a range of zero to one to a range
cues.zh: 所以，把分布從 0 到 1，轉成，

cues.en: of zero to two PI and two PI is sensible because that's going to go all the way around the circle.
cues.zh: 0 到 2π，2π 很合理，因為正好繞完整個圓。

cues.en: So what I'm going to do is multiply this by two times and umpired of pi and now we get vectors that
cues.zh: 乘上 2*np.pi，現在得到的向量，

cues.en: are in theory uniformly distributed all around the circle.
cues.zh: 理論上均勻分布在圓周各處。

cues.en: Of course, you can see, you know, there's a gap over here and there's some higher concentration of vectors over here.
cues.zh: 當然，這裡有空隙，那裡向量比較密集。

cues.en: But that's really just because of the random features of generating this distribution here so we can run it again.
cues.zh: 但那只是這組分布隨機產生的特性，再執行，

cues.en: And you can see that these little gaps will appear in different places.
cues.zh: 就看到小空隙出現在別的位置。

cues.en: And if you run more vectors, if you select more vectors from this uniform distribution, then that's going to fill out the circle even more fully now.
cues.zh: 產生更多向量、從均勻分布選更多樣本，圓周就會填得更完整。

cues.en: I am specifying these angles here in terms of radians, but it's possible that you are more comfortable working with angles in degrees.
cues.zh: 這裡角度使用弧度，不過也許你比較習慣用度。

cues.en: So if you want to know how to convert between radians and degrees, then keep watching because that is the entire purpose of the next video.
cues.zh: 想知道弧度、角度如何互換，請繼續看，下一段就是這個目的。
